title: Grading & regression
summary: Judge actual artifacts and outcomes with the right evidence.

sections.label: Grading approach
items: Deterministic checks for exact state, schemas, identifiers, and test outcomes.
Human judgments for intended behavior and domain support.
Model graders only where calibrated against reviewed references.
Traces and resulting state to verify actions and diagnose failures.

sections.label: Regression policy
sections.text: Re-run relevant evaluations when model, prompt, skill, retrieval, or workflow logic changes. Repeat selected cases when variability is consequential.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: The system’s success declaration is never the sole grade. Reviewers can locate the evidence used to accept or reject a result.

catalog.applicability: Use when deciding how evaluation results will be judged and when they must be re-run. It assigns deterministic checks, human judgment and calibrated model graders to different kinds of evidence and never accepts the system's own success claim as the grade.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
